create_bigquery_service: create a BigQuery service object by authenticating with Google Cloud application default credentials
create_dataset: create a new BigQuery dataset in a specified project using the BigQuery service object
create_partitioned_table: create a partitioned BigQuery table with a 30-day expiration policy and DAY partition type
insert_rows: insert a list of row dictionaries into a BigQuery table using the insertAll API
sync_query_job: execute a synchronous SQL query against BigQuery and return the query job result
